d: South Korea conducts its most important examination for high-school students. Korea's College Scholastic Ability Test, CSAT, also known as the Suneung took place on Thursday even as the nation was rocked by multiple AI cheating scandals. Firstpost looks at how South Korea conducts the Suneung exam. Hem Kaur Saroya explains the recent AI fraud incidents that have shaken South Korea's faith in its examination system. HKS also looks at the steps taken by Seoul to address AI cheating during this year's exam.
